The Story Of Ozzy Osbourne

ai.en: The Story of Ozzy Osbourne is a live concert telling the singer's life from poverty to fame, with a full band and multimedia screens.

events.description: Get onboard the crazy train for heavy metal's greatest story - live, loud, and larger than life. From poverty to the Prince Of Darkness, Ozzy Osbourne's unbelievable story explodes off the stage in this live concert event featuring a full band, incredible true stories, and multimedia on the big screen. This is the story of a man who invented heavy metal with Black Sabbath, got fired from his own band, bit the head off a bat, was given last rites twice, and somehow lived to become the world's most famous dad. It's a tale of addiction, jail cells, sold-out arenas, and a woman named Sharon who refused to let him die. The road was paved with excess, darkness, and moments where survival seemed impossible. But against all odds, Ozzy didn't just survive-he became an inspiration. Iconic hits like "Paranoid," "Crazy Train," "Bark at the Moon," "Iron Man," and "Mama, I'm Coming Home" provide the soundtrack to this wild ride, performed live by Mike Braniff.

events.description: The legendary band KINO celebrated its 40th anniversary in 2022, while Viktor Tsoi would have turned 60. For the first time ever, the band KINO is coming to Canda and the United States with a full-scale concert. Yuri Kasparyan, Igor Tikhomirov, and Alexander Titov will perform KINO's greatest hits for over two hours, accompanied by a restored and digitally remastered voice of Viktor Tsoi. Come to the show and sing along to all the iconic KINO songs together with the entire audience! All Ages Welcome - General Admission Standing & Reserved Seating

events.description: Celebrate the festive holiday season in Calgary with an unforgettable night of music, dance, and community magic. This high-energy, heart-warming extravaganza captures the true joy of the holidays, bringing together Calgary's most brilliant young musicians and dancers to perform dazzling, passion-filled routines live under professional lights. Hosted by the hilarious, legendary a cappella group The Heebee-jeebees, the night features an all-star lineup of Calgary's finest youth talent, including the 7-Time Global Award-Winning Calgary Stampede Showband, The Young Canadians, the Stetson Show Band, the Calgary Round-Up Band, and spectacular special guest performers. It is the perfect winter outing for families and music lovers to experience pure seasonal magic while giving back to our community

The Story of Merle Haggard

ai.en: The Story of Merle Haggard at the Jubilee Auditorium in Calgary, with JUNO-nominated singer Jess Lee telling the country legend's life through songs and stories.

events.description: Be part of a special evening dedicated to one of the greatest artists in country music history - Merle Haggard. In "The Story of Merle Haggard", JUNO-nominated singer Jess Lee will take you on a journey through Haggard's incredible life and times through stories and songs. With a career spanning six decades, Haggard rose from poverty and prison to international fame through his songs about outlaws, underdogs, the heartbroken and the hard-living. Haggard wrote songs for the working class to drink to, dance to, and cry to. He notched 40 No. 1 hits including "Working Man Blues", "Mama Tried", "Silver Wings" and one of the most famous country songs of all time, "Okie From Muskogee". The show also includes the stories from Haggard's life that echo the songs he sang; he was born poor, raised in a converted railway boxcar and turned 21 in prison before turning his life around.

The Story of Waylon Jennings

ai.en: The Story of Waylon Jennings at the Jubilee Auditorium in Calgary, a live show with stories and multimedia about the outlaw country singer.

events.description: Experience an unforgettable evening celebrating country music's greatest outlaw. The Story Of Waylon Jennings will take you through the incredible life and music of the legendary singer through live performances, riveting stories and multimedia. You'll hear his chart-topping hits including "Mamas Don't Let Your Babies Grow Up To Be Cowboys", "Luckenbach Texas", "The Theme From Dukes Of Hazzard" and "Suspicious Minds" (which he recorded with his wife Jessie Colter). You'll also be told about his incredible journey from poverty to playing bass for Buddy Holly to becoming one of the most popular and important artists in country music history. In his career spanning six decades, he sold over 40 million records, played to millions of fans around the world, battled addiction, changed the music industry... and carried dynamite on his bus. The Story Of Waylon Jennings pays tribute to the rebel spirit and enduring legacy of a true country music outlaw.

ai.en: Nickelback's Everything Under the Sun tour at the Saddledome in Calgary. $1 per ticket goes to the California Community Foundation, which supports environmental, animal and humanitarian causes.

events.description: Artist will donate $1 per ticket sold, in the currency applicable to each show (USD for US shows, CAD for Canadian shows), to the California Community Foundation, a 501(c)(3) organization that works directly with Nickelback's All The Right Reasons Foundation. Funds will support environmental, animal, and humanitarian causes worldwide, with the goal of leaving the world a better place than we found it. For more information, visit calfund.org. No portion of the ticket purchase is tax deductible.

events.description: Have the Harlem Globetrotters finally met their match? The Washington Generals and new lineup of rivals step onto the court - hungry for a win, and out to prove it! The Harlem Globetrotters - the team that invented basketball culture - bring the Rivalry Tour to your city as part of their 2027 world tour, with a roster of stars who turn every possession into showtime, quarter after quarter. This is a new experience - you're not just watching, you're part of it. You could get pulled onto the court. Join the squad. Own the jumbotron.. Because anything can happen at a Globetrotters game. A free, all-new pre-game party kicks off the moment doors open, packed with new surprises for longtime fans and first-time families. This is Globetrotters joy - electric, and built for YOU! The rivalry is theirs. The thrill is yours. Get your tickets now. For groups of 10+, please contact 647-201-3349 or Lori@FirstClassGroupTickets.com
